column1: One row per status. Abilities apply these by id through status_apply / status_duration. Add a status by adding a row and teaching Kinds what reads it.

column6: *2* of your broken {LAYERS} are being held down. They stay broken until this wears off.
column20: Holds this many broken layers down: they stay broken while it lasts.

column6: At the end of every round one of your own attacks is turned *on yourself*.
column20: Each round end the victim turns one of its OWN attacks on itself.

column6: Your {EC} is over your {MS}. Your line is being invaded until you burn it down.
column20: DERIVED, not timed: it lasts while ec > ms, so it is never stored in unit.statuses.

column6: {ANGER} has blotted out your aim. *Half* of your attacks miss outright.
column20: The victim fluffs this fraction of its attacks.
